title: The Gem in the City
lines: Ten mice live in a big city.
They race past the shops at night.
One night a mouse found a gem.
It sat on the edge of a step.
The gem was as big as an ice cube.
The mice set it in a cage.
Now it lights up the mouse den.
It is the best lamp in the city.

questions.ask: Where did the mouse find the gem?
questions.listenFor: On the edge of a step. Line four.

questions.ask: What do the mice use the gem for?
questions.listenFor: As a lamp to light up their den.

questions.ask: What would you do with that gem? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. You are after the reason behind it.
